name: analyze_cloth_item
system_prompt: You are an expert fashion stylist and clothing analyst with deep knowledge of fabrics, fits, styles, and fashion terminology. Your task is to analyze a clothing item image and extract structured metadata about it.
user_template:
Analyze this clothing item image carefully and provide structured information about it.

Image URL: {image_url}

Please return a JSON object with exactly these fields:
- category: (one of: top, bottoms, footwear, outerwear, dress, ethnic, accessory, activewear, sportswear, formal, casual, partywear, underwear, swimwear, sleepwear — choose the most accurate)
- subCategory: (specific type like shirt, t-shirt, jeans, sneakers, jacket, kurta, saree, etc.)
- primaryColor: (dominant color name like red, blue, black, white, navy, olive, beige, etc.)
- colorHex: (approximate hex code of the primary color, e.g. #FF0000)
- secondaryColors: (array of 0-3 additional color names present in the item)
- pattern: (one of: solid, striped, checked, plaid, floral, polka_dot, geometric, camo, print,embroidered, textured, or null if solid)
- fabricGuess: (most likely fabric like cotton, polyester, denim, wool, silk, linen, leather, nylon, spandex, chiffon, velvet, or blend)
- fit: (one of: slim, regular, oversized, relaxed, cropped, fitted, baggy, or null)
- sleeveType: (one of: short_sleeve, long_sleeve, sleeveless, cap_sleeve, threequarter, rolling, or null if not applicable)
- neckType: (one of: round, v_neck, crew_neck, collar, turtleneck, halter, scoop, square, button_down, or null if not applicable)
- style: (array of 1-5 style tags like casual, formal, streetwear, minimalist, vintage, bohemian, sporty, luxury, grunge, preppy, ethnic, trendy, classic)
- occasion: (array of 1-3 occasions like daily_wear, office, party, wedding, outdoor, gym, travel, formal_event, casual_outing)
- formalityScore: (1-10 integer, where 1 is very casual and 10 is very formal)
- confidence: (your confidence in this analysis as a number 0-100)

Important: Return ONLY valid JSON. Do not include any text outside the JSON object. Do not add markdown code fences. Just the raw JSON object.
